name: Match kickoff time renders with locale-specific month names
description: Dates must be localized, not just wrapped in a span. The same match's kickoff <time> must render with English month spelling on /en and a Spanish month spelling on /es (e.g. an English month name versus a Spanish one). The test compares the two locales rather than asserting a fixed string, so it only passes when the date text genuinely localized.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and capture the first match id
Navigate to /en/match/<captured-id> and read the visible kickoff date/time text in the <time> element
Navigate to /es/match/<captured-id> and read the visible kickoff date/time text in the <time> element

Verify the Spanish kickoff date text uses Spanish month/weekday naming and differs from the English rendering of the same instant (the date string is genuinely re-formatted, not byte-identical English). If both locales show the same English month text, the test fails.
